title: Orchestra watcher fetcher output (protocol v1)
description: The JSON document a watcher fetcher must write to stdout when it exits with code 0. Empty or omitted 'items' means nothing new this tick.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version of this document. Optional; when omitted Orchestra assumes the version it sent ("1").

items.description: Items produced this tick. Each element is an arbitrary JSON value; objects are recommended so dedup keys and parameter templates can address fields. Empty or null means nothing new.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor Orchestra should remember and send back on the next tick. Null or omitted leaves the stored cursor unchanged.

diagnostics.description: Optional structured information logged by Orchestra at Information level. Never used for dispatch.
